check.description: Chain, recompute, signatures and bindings, the journal reconciliation, the whole-set rules.

disposition.description: Disposition one suggestion — with the owner, every time (round 28).

ratify.description: The sitting (03 §1.12): a list of typed writes under ONE signature. `dry_run` runs the same function minus the signature and the writes and returns the verdicts — `{id: [{rule, path, detail}]}`, typed records keyed by card id, a `validate.failed` verdict carrying its own `verdicts` — and the exact display the signer shows.

document.description: the same shape as `write`'s document; the store validates it identically. Not re-embedded here: the card schema is ~20 KB and a planner session pays `tools/list` on every invocation — the constraint that matters is at `write`, where documents are authored (03b §4; the WP3 review's E2).

show.description: The one typed read (03 §1.2): a card, the board, the queue, the inbox or a registry schema.

suggest.description: Hand something noticed back to the tenant as a suggestion (03a): never a card, never guidance — the planner dispositions it with the owner.

write.description: Write one governed document (03 §1.2): validate, compare-and-swap on the history head, derive the act from the diff, sign if the predicate says so, journal, write, commit. `new_slug` creates a card (the store allocates the id); otherwise `card` names an existing one and `base` is its head.

scope.description: the `## Scope` section — the owner's words verbatim (T-B1)

updates.description: append-only dated blocks (log class); the store stamps the header

CardHead.description: A card's typed head (03 §2.1). Conditionally required keys are Optional here; the profile (03 §3) decides.
CardHead.title: CardHead
